- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:187-198 (commit-selftest-status job; also 344-448) | severity=medium | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: The commit-selftest-status job has no concurrency group, so overlapping runs can each list open status PRs before either creates its own and end up with competing status PRs.
  WHY: Neither run's supersede list includes the other's PR, so both update the same status file. Severity disagreement: gemini rated MAJOR, the others NIT. The next run supersedes both, so impact is transient.
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:348-352 (unchanged early exit, before supersede loop at 437-448) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `outcome=unchanged reason=matches_open_pr` early exit skips the loop that closes older superseded status PRs.
  WHY: Stale open status PRs remain until a later night produces a different status. This is operational noise only.

  PROBLEM: The registry documents `branch=` for every `outcome=failed` reason, but `reason=gh_pat_missing` and `reason=run_context_invalid` emit only `token=`.
  WHY: A log consumer parsing the documented field list will not find `branch=` for those two outcomes.

  PROBLEM: The changelog says the nightly status no longer fails the run when the push is refused, but the step still exits non-zero with `reason=push_rejected_by_ruleset` (workflow lines 410-417).
  WHY: An operator may expect a ruleset refusal to leave the run green.
- .github/workflows/nightly-validation-selftest.yml:424 (gh pr create --base "${TARGET_BRANCH}"; TARGET_BRANCH at line 318) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The status PR targets `github.ref_name` rather than `main`, so a manual dispatch from a non-main branch opens the PR into that branch.
  WHY: The issue requires a PR into main. Severity disagreement: gemini and minimax rated MAJOR, openai and z-ai NIT. Note that sonnet-5_5 considered this behavior-preserving and did not report it.
- agents.d/8225-nightly-selftest-status-push.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The existing entry still says the status commit pushes with `secrets.GH_PAT || github.token`, but the new implementation requires `GH_PAT` and rejects the `github.token` fallback.
  WHY: When `GH_PAT` is absent the workflow exits with `reason=gh_pat_missing` before pushing, contrary to this text.

  PROBLEM: A transient API error on `gh pr create` leaves an orphaned bot branch and a red run. Suggested fix: retry once or twice with a short sleep (6-8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. All deliverables are present. The `--base` choice was deliberately not reported.
